verdict.rationale: monday.com is a work-management and agent platform, not a code host or code-review tool, so AI-driven breakdown and explanation of code diffs is outside its product category. The evidence only shows linking GitHub/GitLab pull requests to items, which is not diff analysis and does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can have AI break a code diff into focused sections with explanations of what changed and why
